name: IL-11
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 6-point Democratic lean plus a favorable national environment
Foster's incumbency and large financial advantage ($2.5M cash vs $23K)
No outside spending or opposition activity against Foster
model.rationale: Fundamentals point strongly to Foster: a D+6 district, a favorable environment, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over Jeff Walter, who has almost no cash on hand. Markets price the race around 95% Democratic, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or a polling surprise showing Walter within single digits would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bill Foster seeks another term in this Democratic-leaning Illinois district, where the partisan lean of about six points gives him a structural advantage. The national environment also favors his party this cycle, adding to the fundamentals behind his bid.

Foster has raised over $2.1 million and holds $2.5 million on hand, while Republican Jeff Walter has raised roughly $311,000 with only about $23,000 remaining. No outside groups have targeted the race, and prediction markets price Foster's chances near 95%. With no public polls available, the forecast rests on these fundamentals, all of which point to a comfortable Foster win.
